articles.title: Fears for children's safety in West Bank school as settler attacks rise
articles.description: Six people, including three pupils at the Palestinian school, have been killed in al-Mughayyir this year, in a surge of Israeli settler-related violence.

articles.title: A&E did not get the basics right - my son's life was ruined at 32
articles.description: Oli's experience is one of a growing number of clinical negligence claims being made in England, BBC analysis shows.

articles.title: Canadian counter-tariffs come into force escalating US trade dispute
articles.description: The tariffs will apply to $20bn worth of American products, jeopardising the stability of the world's largest bilateral trading relationship.

articles.title: Prince George set for first day at Eton College
articles.description: The 13-year-old will follow in the footsteps of his father, the Prince of Wales, by attending the elite private school.
